calibration_sources: Anthropic Contextual Retrieval (Prompt-Cached Document Header + BM25 + Reranker) Failure-Rate Reduction Model
Jina AI Late-Chunking (Long-Context Transformer Token Pooling Prior to Chunking)
Microsoft Research LazyGraphRAG & HKU LightRAG (Noun-Phrase Concept Graph vs Eager Full LLM Graph Extraction Cost/Quality)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Naive 512-Token Fixed Chunking + Dense Vector Top-K
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 传统 512-Token 硬切片 + 纯稠密向量 Top-K 检索
tiers.indexing_mechanism: Sliding 512-token window + Single Dense Embedding (bge-large / text-embedding-3)

tiers.name: Tier 2: Hybrid BM25 + Dense Vector (RRF) + Cross-Encoder Reranker (bge-reranker-v2)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 混合检索 (BM25 + 向量 RRF) + Cross-Encoder 精排
tiers.indexing_mechanism: Sparse SPLADE/BM25 + Dense Embedding + Top-50 -> Top-5 Cross-Encoder Rerank

tiers.name: Tier 3: Contextual Retrieval (Prefix-Cached Context Header / Late-Chunking) + Hybrid Rerank
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 上下文增强切片 (Contextual Retrieval / Late-Chunking) + 混合精排
tiers.indexing_mechanism: Document-Level KV Prefix Context Header (or Long-Context Late Pooling) + BM25 + Dense + Rerank

tiers.name: Tier 4: Adaptive Router -> Contextual Hybrid RAG + LazyGraphRAG / LightRAG (Concept Subgraph + On-Demand Community Synthesis)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 自适应路由 + 上下文混合检索 + LazyGraphRAG/LightRAG 按需子图归纳
tiers.indexing_mechanism: NLP Noun-Phrase Concept Co-occurrence Graph + Leiden Hierarchy + Query-Time Iterative Subgraph Map-Reduce
